title: The Same Crossing
logline: A ferryman makes the same short crossing dozens of times a day, in flat dawn stillness and in a wind-driven afternoon chop, arriving each time at the same far bank by a different road.

object.note: Object 10 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: One crossing becomes many: a ferryman's same short lagoon crossing in stillness and in chop, reaching the same bank by a different way each time.

thread_out.thread: Having reached the far bank, the question turns to what is left behind for good: a farmer digging out, root and all, a weed that has returned every season.

requirements: A working ferry crossing with a willing operator
Filming across enough of a season to capture different water conditions
Passenger consent for any close filming

suggestions.name: Batticaloa lagoon
suggestions.why: A well-known lagoon with small local ferry crossings.

lesson.in_simple_terms: Two people can reach the same place by very different roads. The road colours what arriving feels like, even though where they arrive does not change.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: එකම තැනට විවිධ මාර්ගවලින් පැමිණිය හැකිය; පැමිණි තැන වෙනස් නොවුණත්, ගමන් කළ මාර්ගය පැමිණීමේ ස්වභාවයට බලපායි.
lesson.the_teaching: The texts count the eight supramundane minds (lokuttara citta) again by the depth of calm behind them, so that the eight become forty. Someone who reaches the path taking an absorption as the basis for insight has path and fruition minds that carry that absorption's factors: at four levels the moment comes with gladness, at the deepest with even equanimity. The stage reached is the same; the texture of arrival differs. The texts' very name for these minds rests on the idea of carrying across, beyond the worlds of existence.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: The same short lagoon crossing is filmed in flat dawn stillness and in a wind-driven afternoon chop, with the ferryman reading the water and adjusting as he goes. Passengers cross for ordinary, varied reasons. The moment of arrival at the far bank looks almost the same each time, and that sameness after such different journeys is what the viewer is left to notice.

key_terms.en: supramundane mind: a mind beyond the worldly
absorption used as the basis for insight

lesson.caution: It does not mean the road does not matter, and the ferry is not a picture of awakening: the texts say the road leaves its mark on the arrival, and these minds are beyond anything a camera can show.
lesson.builds_on: The rope crossing showed one decisive letting go; this film repeats a crossing many times to show what the texts add, that the same arrival can be reached from different depths of calm.
lesson.evidence_class: editorial interpretation grounded in cited source teaching
